probes.title: A tone that comes and goes, a tone that climbs, close pairs of tones and noise: the columns and the rows of the map of frequency against time, and what a cell reads

axes.purpose: unfiltered: 100 Hz at 10 deg/s from 3 to 3.5 s, 6 to 7 s, 9 to 11 s, 12.5 to 12.6 s and 13.5 to 13.52 s: how long a column is and how far a short tone spreads; filtered: 200 Hz at 2 deg/s all the time: the level of a steady tone
unfiltered: a tone of 10 deg/s that climbs evenly from 50 to 450 Hz over the flight: where a moment of the flight lies on the time axis; filtered: pairs of tones 4, 8 and 16 Hz apart: the rows
unfiltered: white noise of 5 deg/s RMS: the floor; filtered: noise of the same density between 100 and 300 Hz only: smoothing along the frequency

probes.title: A flight made for no question in particular: the throttle moves as it likes, motor noise follows it; the rule of round 10 says what the map shows

axes.purpose: unfiltered: a tone of 8 deg/s at 70 Hz + 3 Hz per percent with its second harmonic at 3 deg/s, over noise of 2 deg/s RMS; filtered: the same at 3 and 1 deg/s over noise of 1 deg/s
unfiltered: a tone of 5 deg/s at 180 Hz, 120 Hz at 15 deg/s from 8 to 8.4 s, over noise of 3 deg/s RMS; filtered: noise of 1 deg/s RMS
unfiltered: noise between 60 and 350 Hz with a density of 0.02 (deg/s)²/Hz and a tone of 4 deg/s at 50 Hz + 2 Hz per percent; filtered: that tone at 1 deg/s
